newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Campbell Soup cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Campbell Soup cut.

text.p: -- BT Securities said it downgraded Campbell Soup Co to market perform from buy.
-- said the stock has increased more than 40 percent in value since BT Securities upgraded the stock. The date of that upgrade was not immediately available.
-- said the firm decided to downgraded the stock on Thursday since the "near-term upside potential is insufficient" to support a buy rating.
-- said fiscal year 1997 earnings per share are being driven by a six-percent effective price increase in U.S. soup. Fiscal 1998 will have a 3.5 percent price increase.
-- said Campbell Soup should meet fiscal 1998 earnings per share forecasts due to continued margin gains.
-- expects Campbell Soup to earn $2.11 a share in fiscal 1998.
